indication: Symptoms of opiate, alcohol, and benzodiazepine withdrawal
Oxygen toxicity during hyperbaric oxygen therapy
recommended_usage: swallowed with water || take without food
mechanism_of_action: enhances the activity of specific neurotransmitters of the brain
side_effects: dizziness, drowsiness, blurred vision, tiredness, unsteadiness, mental or mood changes such as agitation, memory problems, confusion, hallucinations, depression, restlessness, signs of infection- fever, chills, sore throat that doesn't go away, shallow breathing
unsuitable_population: pregnant women, nursing mothers, individuals with lung or breathing issues such as sleep apnea, COPD-chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder, an individual or family history of any substance use disorder (such as abuse or addiction to drugs or alcohol), mental or mood changes such as psychosis, depression, thoughts of suicide
